d:
What if your teacher was secretly a SPY?
Not the kind who saves the world… the kind who can smell Maggi from four benches away, catch you cheating with a single clue, and somehow know exactly where you've been bunking class.
This Teacher’s Day, we’re turning the most iconic school moments into a full-blown spy operation.
From cheating in exams and eating in class to recess missions, rogue students, secret informers and one teacher who is ALWAYS three steps ahead… Smita Ma’am is on a mission to keep the school under control.
